idle.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Production raster for a native children's clock-learning game. Edit the provided reference of Dozy the Dreamsaurus. Produce one 1536 square genuinely transparent RGBA full character, isolated without any shadow, floor, backdrop, texture outside character or alpha haze. Preserve the existing plush 3D illustrated character exactly: left-facing calm closed eyes, broad blue cheek and muzzle, blue spotted long neck and quadruped body, four short feet, pale warm cream belly, lavender sleeping cap with pale lavender brim and cream pompom, lavender midnight quilt with cream piping and gold moon and stars, complete functioning-looking gold pocket watch including hoop, clear ivory dial and blue ticks and two blue hands, curled blue tail. Don't redesign, crop, change height, angle, facial proportions, quilt or lighting. Keep the reference pixel framing relative to the square, approximately x 16 to 92 percent, y 4.4 to 94 percent, head centered near (32%,29%), foot baseline at 93.5%. Keep every toe, tail and pompom. The reference is already the precise angle and framing. Remove only background and floor shadow, keep smooth opaque silhouette with natural antialiased boundaries. No lettering, typography, border or effects.

reactions.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Transparent square RGBA sprite sheet, exactly 2×2 uniform square cells with uninterrupted transparent gutters, no grid lines or labels. Each cell is a full-body isolated version of the reference Dozy the Dreamsaurus, same camera angle, light, texture, sleepy eye spacing, blue spotted neck, same purple sleep cap with cream pompom, lavender gold-star quilt with cream piping and the same readable complete ivory and gold pocket watch with blue hands, curled tail, four short feet or one/two raised front paws while balancing seated. Exact order: top left calm original idle pose; top right sitting on hind feet with both short front paws open at chest height ready to clap; bottom left same seated pose with both short front paws visibly touching at center chest, below muzzle, in a happy clap; bottom right original stance with worried closed eyelids and gentle frown, still all feet planted. The expression changes, yet the face, head size, eye separation, muzzle shape, hat, clock and material proportions must stay locked. Fixed internal framing, head top at 6% and planted soles at 94% of each cell, complete character with a clear margin. Match original left-facing three-quarter orientation in all cells. No background, shadow, effects, motion trails, marks or text.

motion.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Transparent square RGBA sheet exactly 2×2 uniform square cells, fixed scale per cell, complete character with margin, no labels or lines. Don't draw a floor, shadow, motion lines, glow or extra accessories. True alpha outside each character.

space.source: Top-left registration canvas, 512 × 512. Rig points use source pixels. Opening raster uses 1254/512 × each coordinate.
space.prepared: X reflects once at render preparation (pixel indices: width − 1 − x, normalized positions: 1 − x). Y is unchanged. The visible clock has ticks and hands without numerals.
space.screen: The prepared canvas scales to SwiftUI points. Device pixel density affects only screen rasterization.
space.handContact: Clap contact is the measured palm seam in the registered source. Stumble and push-up paw pairs share horizontal midpoint 173.

materials.format: VLY1. RLE per asset, top-left source pixel order. Low three bits are material, bit 3 is cap plus pompom, bit 4 is isolated full head.

channels.0: Protected dial, ticks, hands and facial ink
channels.1: Purple fabric on cap and quilt (bandana)
channels.2: Gold embroidery, watch hoop and case (spikes)
channels.3: Blue skin, including cheeks and darker spots (body)
channels.4: Cream belly, tail underside, trim and pompom (belly)
